high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of a white Adidas sneaker being held by someone's hand. The sneaker features the Adidas logo on the side and a small Ferrari logo near the heel, indicating a collaboration between Adidas and Ferrari. The shoe has a classic design with three horizontal stripes on the side and white laces. The background is somewhat cluttered, with various items scattered around, including what appears to be boxes with images of people on them. One box prominently displays a man in a white shirt, while another shows a woman in a yellow top.
